# Reporting a security issue

Do not post credentials, access tokens, account databases or private logs in public issues.
Use GitHub's **Security → Report a vulnerability** when private reporting is enabled:
https://github.com/B23101/Shaurma-Launcher/security/advisories/new

If that page is unavailable, open an issue asking for a private contact without describing
the vulnerability or attaching sensitive files. Wait for a private channel before sharing details.

Reports should identify the affected version, operating system, reproducible steps and impact.
Include SHA-256 hashes and CI run links for suspicious release files. Disclose suspected embedded
credentials privately. The maintainers coordinate fixes and disclosure with the reporter.

Security fixes target the latest release. Older installations should update before retesting.
